Priya Singh: FYI support escalated — multiple customers reporting 5xx/timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-west and eu-west since ~03:40 UTC. Customers see 502/504 on generate calls.
Ethan Kline: I can reproduce a small spike locally by replaying traces, looks like gateway timeouts when seqlen > 1024.
Maya Lopez: Observed auth proxy 504 bursts around same window, error rate correlated with KMS auth latency.
Jason (support): Customer A (ACME) provided request_id=acme-1379, sample payload attached. They hit it via our SDK v0.9.1.
Priya Singh: Thanks — opening short war-room handoff. Can ppl paste latest gateway logs and circuit breaker metrics?
Ethan Kline: Pasted snippet: ```
[03:41:12] gateway: upstream_timeout host=runtime-1 pool=gpupool-3 path=/v1/generate status=504
[03:41:13] runtime: kvcache_miss model=gptx-16b seq=1200
```
Maya Lopez: KMS latencies spiked to 800-1200ms for a subset of tokens, auth retries bubbled up. See datapoint: https://internals/redwood/metrics/abc123
Priya Singh: Immediate mitigation idea: 1) enable endpoint fallback to quantized model (gptx-16b-q8) 2) increase gateway upstream timeout to 12s 3) temporarily raise concurrency cap for affected routes. Can we action?
Ben (eng lead): Agree. I'll roll a config patch to switch fallback model for affected customer routes. Ethan, please coordinate gateway timeout bump. Maya, look into KMS throttle window and temporary retry backoff tweak.
Ethan Kline: Rolling timeout bump now: `kubectl apply -f gateway-config.yaml` (patch attached). I pushed canary to 2 nodes first.
Maya Lopez: Added temporary KMS backoff: jittered exponential with cap 750ms, also flagged for KMS vendor.
Jason (support): Communicating mitigation to customers — will include repro steps and ask them to confirm. Customer A confirmed reduction in errors after fallback.
Priya Singh: Postmortem checklist we need: impact window, root cause hypothesis (auth/KMS + kv-cache misses + long seqlen), timeline of mitigations, customer comm drafts, action owners + due dates.
Ben (eng lead): Actions I own: rollback plan if fallback causes regressions, and post-deploy perf baseline. Due EOD tomorrow.
Ethan Kline: Actions I own: full gateway rollout of timeout + monitor run for 24h, add metric alert for seqlen-heavy timeouts. Due in 4h for rollout, alerting tomorrow.
Maya Lopez: Actions I own: KMS vendor escalation, increase KMS client pool to reduce head-of-line waits, add tagging for slow auth requests. ETA 24h.
Jason (support): I'll prepare customer follow-up template and list of affected accounts. ETA 2h.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1839999999, severity=P2, postmortem_required=true
Priya Singh: OK set. Everyone drop any additional notes in this thread. We'll convert to a retrospective doc tomorrow and include concrete CLs and runbook updates. :thumbsup:
Ethan Kline: One small repro snippet for docs: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-16b","input":"<very long prompt>"}'` — you can see timeout at >10s when kvcache miss + auth slow.
Maya Lopez: Also adding a note: consider pre-warm / KV cache seeding for enterprise customers during peak windows.
Priya Singh: Thanks team — logging action items into Jira and assigning owners. Will post follow-up with links to runbook edits and the postmortem draft by tomorrow morning.
Jason (support): Customer comm sent. They appreciated the quick workaround. Will update if they see anything else.
Ben (eng lead): Closing loop: once postmortem draft is ready we'll schedule a 30min sync to review action items and assign timelines.
